Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring an analysis of teleworking options within environmental impact statements on proposed transportation projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to teleworking options within environmental impactstatements on proposed transportation projects; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An environmental impact statement required under RCW 43.21C.031that is prepared on a proposed transportation project must include ananalysis of how the proposed alternatives identified in the statementmay be affected by teleworking as applied to any traffic modelingperformed as part of the environmental impact statement process. Forpurposes of this section, "teleworking" means a program where workfunctions that are normally performed at a traditional workplace areinstead performed by an employee at his or her home at least one day aweek for the purpose of reducing the number of trips to the employee'sworkplace.
